hangzhou-2005.notes: Source 5 (ZJUPC2005.pdf, found under the icpc2005 site) is the problem set of the Zhejiang University Programming Contest 2005 (ZyXEL Cup) of 16 April 2005, eight problems 1001-1008, not the Hangzhou regional; it should be moved or dropped. The ZOJ pages (sources 8-16, problems 2613-2621) print no contest name, so their attribution to Hangzhou 2005 rests on the catalogue and the consecutive numbering.

hangzhou-2022.notes: XCPCIO board: our copy has 659 team rows of which only the first 32 are rendered (the rest are empty virtual-scroll rows); a recapture or the board's data file would give the full field. Times are printed as 2022-12-03 22:00 to 2022-12-04 03:00 CST, so contest_date left null.

sources.evidence: XCPCIO board titled for the 47th ICPC Asia Regional Hangzhou site (official contest), with columns Place, Organization, Team, Solved, Penalty, A to M; only 32 team rows are filled.

hangzhou-2023.notes: Editorial slides give G as 'Snake', H as 'Sweet Sugar II' and E as 'Period of String' (catalogue: Snake Move, Sugar Sweet II, Period of a String). The slide date 12.10.2023 can be read two ways and is the editorial's date, so contest_date is null. The editorial cover does not name Hangzhou; the match rests on the problem names.
